CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that an enabled GuardDuty detector exists in every region.
Risk: Without GuardDuty, credential compromise, crypto-mining, reconnaissance and data exfiltration indicators are not detected.

Recommendation.Text: Enable GuardDuty in all regions (ideally via a delegated administrator for the organization).

Notes: Not a numbered CIS AWS 3.0 control; mapped to 4.16 (managed threat detection / Security Hub).
